title: Jean Miélot in his scriptorium (Escribano.jpg)
author: Attributed to Jean Le Tavernier (miniaturist); scan via Wikimedia Commons
alt_text: Fifteenth-century illuminated miniature of the scribe Jean Miélot seated at a slanted writing desk, copying a manuscript in a Burgundian scriptorium.
license: Public domain (author died more than 100 years ago)
notes: Miélot was scribe, translator, and secretary to Philip the Good, Duke of Burgundy — literacy as a guarded court craft.
